recommendation_reason: Kept: criticality 2 and derived usefulness 95 do not meet the prune gate, and no test named in the uniqueness note covers the same assertion and input (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/theme.rs:22-250).

criticality_reason: Unreadable text in one theme is a bounded visual failure (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/theme.rs:22-250).
signal_reason: Computes WCAG contrast ratios for eleven roles on three surfaces per theme plus four additional pair thresholds (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/theme.rs:698-737).
uniqueness_reason: The audit row checks token identity; this row is the only computed-legibility invariant, and it covers themes the RGB snapshots never touch (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/theme.rs:22-250).
fidelity_reason: The arithmetic runs over production tokens; the contrast formula is test-local but the subject is the real palettes (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/theme.rs:22-250).
recommendation_reason: Kept: criticality 2 and derived usefulness 95 do not meet the prune gate, and no test named in the uniqueness note covers the same assertion and input (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/theme.rs:22-250).
cost_drivers: whole added-catalog iteration with per-pair arithmetic
